name: Royal Guard
desc: A mechanized soldier created to protect royalty.

name: Skull Guardian
desc: This monster can only be Ritual Summoned with the Ritual Spell Card, "Novox's Prayer". You must also offer monsters whose total Level Stars equal 7 or more as a Tribute from the field or your hand.

name: Lord of D.
desc: All Dragon-Type monsters cannot be targeted by Spell Cards, Trap Cards, or other effects that specifically designate a target while this card is face-up on the field.

name: Novox's Prayer
desc: This card is used to Ritual Summon "Skull Guardian". You must also offer monsters whose total Level Stars equal 7 or more as a Tribute from the field or your hand.

name: Spellbinding Circle
desc: Select 1 monster.  As long as this card remains face-up on the field, the selected monster cannot attack or change its battle position except by the effect of a Spell, Trap or Effect Monster Card. When the selected monster is destroyed, this card is also destroyed. If the selected monster is offered as a Tribute, this card is not destroyed.

name: Rocket Warrior
desc: The effect of this card can only be applied during the Battle Phase of your own turn. Any damage this monster takes is reduced to 0. Any monster attacked by this card has its ATK decreased by 500 points until the end of that turn.

name: Key Mace #2
desc: The power of this monster lies in its ability to suppress the good and bring out the bad in any monster.

name: Worm Drake
desc: Once this monster wraps itself around a victim, there is no escape.

name: Dimensionhole
desc: Remove 1 monster on your side of the field from play until your next Standby Phase. The card still counts towards the 5-card Monster Zone limit.

name: Skull Servant
desc: A skeletal ghost that isn't strong but can mean trouble in large numbers.

name: Winged Dragon, Guardian of the Fortress #2
desc: This monster's wings are capable of generating tornadoes.

name: Alligator's Sword
desc: This lizard man can swing a sword at velocities that exceed the speed of sound.

name: Uraby
desc: Fast on its feet, this dinosaur rips enemies to shreds with its sharp claws.

name: Remove Trap
desc: Destroys 1 face-up Trap Card on the field.

name: Waboku
desc: Any damage inflicted by an opponent's monster is decreased to 0 during the turn this card is activated.

name: Laughing Flower
desc: A flower whose laugh can confuse the minds of enemies.

name: One-Eyed Shield Dragon
desc: This dragon wears a shield not only for its own protection, but also for ramming its enemies.

name: Kuriboh
desc: Discard this card from your hand to the Graveyard to make the damage inflicted to your Life Points by 1 opponent's monster 0. This effect must be activated during your opponent's Battle Phase.

name: Scapegoat
desc: When this card is activated, you cannot summon any monster in the same turn (including Flip Summon and Special Summon).  Place 4 "Sheep Token" (Beast-Type/EARTH/1 Star/ATK 0/DEF 0) in Defense Position on the your side of the field. The tokens cannot be used as a Tribute for a Tribute Summon.

name: Obelisk the Tormentor
desc: The descent of this mighty creature shall be heralded by burning winds and twisted land. And with the coming of this horror, those who draw breath shall know the true meaning of eternal slumber.

name: Slifer the Sky Dragon
desc: The heavens twist and thunder roars, signaling the coming of this ancient creature, and the dawn of true power.

name: The Winged Dragon of Ra
desc: Spirits sing of a powerful creature that rules over all that is mystic
